During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] went on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in order to investigate the disappearance of [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].
